note: Trigger for meas-session.yml (9.9 campaign). A push that changes this file starts the runs it names. One subject, session. repeats is one list or a map subject -> list. mode: dry | probe | full — probe is the long-phase probe and is never a repeat. Every other value is a constant in dataset/tools/meas/session/run.sh. A dry run sets cpu_model to "" so machine_gate opens on any model: it verifies the tooling, is never pooled and is not a repeat. stop_after (repeat -> stage: install | priming | pinned | edge | end) stops a dry job cleanly after that stage; a diagnostic, ignored outside mode dry. login_mode (repeat -> unit | gdm | stub) picks the login path for the Q14 comparison.
